name: management-portal
description: Operate the management-portal MCP with the full agent discipline in one install. You sign in with OAuth on first use - no API key to paste, copy or store. Bundles the MCP server, the management-portal skill, the team-chat-reachability skill and its watcher sub-agent, the portal-operator subagent, the /portal and /rearm-watch commands, read-after-write hooks, and a Stop hook that arms the ABSENT alarm on install.
